answer: Persistent attention escrow: each identity must hold a jetty of unbroken, publicly logged task-attention before its actions count. The rule: an identity's weight equals its longest continuous verified attention streak, not its count. To forge N identities, an attacker must sustain N parallel attention streams, paying real labor-hours and a sable-level operational overhead per stream that cannot be pooled or shortcut. Streaks reset on any gap. The opal threshold for action eligibility rises with streak length, so fresh identities stay near-zero weight until costly sustained effort accumulates.
